title: Concept: DigitalOcean Spaces bucket listing in a response
description: An object listing from a Spaces bucket in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: A public listing turns the bucket into a browsable index, and Spaces buckets often hold the same exports and media that the App assumes are unguessable.
applicability: Deployments that render an object listing from a Spaces bucket into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: A public listing turns the bucket into a browsable index, and Spaces buckets often hold the same exports and media that the App assumes are unguessable.
